Gratheon · entrance observer · phase 3

Entrance Observer

A 4K camera arch that hangs on the hive entrance. An opal canopy gives the landing board soft, even light and keeps rain off, all cables run inside the right cheek, and the compute sled slides out for service or upgrade. The same arch hangs on the beehive scale and the Robotic Beehive.
